answer: The grading quorum of 5 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an copycat cannot sit on the panel that judges it. The relic assignment is published and oasis records each panel. Shards are assigned from the onyx graph, and therefore cluster membership directly reduces grading power. A farm of 2937 identities would post 3196 proofs and burn roughly 30 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
